answer_text:
Bootstrapped startups should keep costs predictable and avoid tools they'll outgrow in six months. Worth a look:

1. Northwind CRM Essentials - powerful and well supported, though per-seat costs climb quickly past the starter tier.
2. Pipewell - pipeline-first and very visual; a good pick if your process is mostly deal stages.
3. Tallyfox Starter - simple pipelines, a mobile app people actually use and pricing from $12 per user; reporting is lighter than the big suites.
4. Sheetly - spreadsheet-based CRM templates — free and familiar, but they break down past a few hundred contacts.

Trial Northwind CRM and Pipewell side by side with a real week of deals — the better fit is usually obvious by Friday.
